title: Organical

inlines.v: ORGAN'ICAL, a. [l. organicus.] 1. Pertaining to an organ or to organs; consisting of organs or containing them; as the organic structure of the human body or of plants.2. Produced by the organs; as organic pleasure.3. Instrumental; acting as instruments of nature or art to a certain end; as organic arts.Organic bodies, are such as possess organs, on the action of which depend their growth and perfection; as animals and plants.
